 Chet Holmgren scores 14 points Tuesday 
 by Leo Sells | Thunder Correspondent | Wed, Oct 21st 2026, 8:19am EDT 
 Chet Holmgren scored 14 points (3-8 FG, 0-1 3PT, 8-8 FT) to go with seven rebounds and four blocks in Tuesday's 116-104 win over the San Antonio Spurs. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Holmgren played a pretty good game on Tuesday. He left something to be desired with his efficiency from the field, but he still ended with 14 points and was able to supplement that well in other areas of the game. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the position over the course of the season.
